items.t: The Peloton Turnaround Story: Here's the Good News, the Bad News, and Where Its Stock Could Go Next
items.sum: Peloton's revenue has declined significantly over the last five years, led by shrinking exercise equipment sales.

items.t: Peloton: More Profitable, But The Subscriber Base Is Shrinking (Rating Downgrade)
items.sum: Analyst rates Peloton a Sell: sub-2% churn and weak sign-ups pressure its subscriber base; shares may remain dead money without new growth initiatives.

items.t: How to Play NKE Stock as Nike Risks Becoming a Forever Turnaround Story
items.sum: Nike announced a new long-term turnaround roadmap during Investor Day. The announcements, however, failed to impress the market, with the stock dropping 6% on Nov. 17.

items.t: Wonder is letting anyone launch a virtual restaurant with AI
items.sum: Wonder Create is Marc Lore’s new initiative that lets people turn an idea into a branded digital storefront, set their own margins, and earn money from orders: no culinary expertise or lease rental required.
